question: What kind of object and result does the Śaiva scripture uniquely establish beyond other means?
premises: Other means have their own objects and results
The scripture states an object and result of its own
Its teaching rests on that unique domain
inference: Therefore the scripture establishes an object and result resting on its own proper domain.
plain_english: And having stated its own object and result, it rests upon its own proper object and result.
